# pve_ceph_flags (Resource)

All cluster-wide Ceph flags at once (nobackfill, noout, noup, ...); cluster is a constant id anchor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_ceph_flags" "example" {
  cluster = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) (default: cluster)

### Optional

- `nobackfill` (Boolean) Backfilling of PGs is suspended.
- `nodeep_scrub` (Boolean) Deep Scrubbing is disabled.
- `nodown` (Boolean) OSD failure reports are being ignored, such that the monitors will not mark OSDs down.
- `noin` (Boolean) OSDs that were previously marked out will not be marked back in when they start.
- `noout` (Boolean) OSDs will not automatically be marked out after the configured interval.
- `norebalance` (Boolean) Rebalancing of PGs is suspended.
- `norecover` (Boolean) Recovery of PGs is suspended.
- `noscrub` (Boolean) Scrubbing is disabled.
- `notieragent` (Boolean) Cache tiering activity is suspended.
- `noup` (Boolean) OSDs are not allowed to start.
- `pause` (Boolean) Pauses read and writes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: cluster (also the `terraform import` format).
